summary: A function whose docstring names a parameter as the repository root must prune .claude/worktrees (a worktrees filter or iter_files_pruned) before walking that parameter; suppress with a reasoned # tree-walk-ok marker. Source scope by default.
changelog: - New gate `unpruned_tree_walk` (hard, no advisory mode, source scope): a function documented as taking a repository root must not walk it (rglob, glob, walk, os.walk) without pruning `.claude/worktrees`. Suppress with `# tree-walk-ok: <reason>`.
owner_actions: Add a [[gate]] entry for unpruned_tree_walk to src/py_ci_shared/registry.toml and a README catalogue row (owner-owned files; not edited here).

The round file's 3 mlframe hits came from a broader heuristic (any walked parameter). The gate now requires a docstring that names the parameter as the repository root, which is why the measured count is 0; the broader cases are not checked by this gate by design.
